title: 第21章 为非作歹第22章 一丝心动
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;辰南抬头望去，看见了两道倩影。
为首的是一名紫衣女子。
她拥有着绝美如画般的容颜，肌肤晶莹如雪，在其眉心有一颗美人痣，为她增添了一丝妖媚之感。
她拥有着一双狭长的丹凤眼，鼻梁挺翘，但嘴唇微薄，给人一种刻薄的感觉。
只一眼，辰南便认出了紫衣女子的身份来历。
林梦瑶，林家一脉的少主，同时也是紫薇圣地的第七圣女。
她身怀凤骨圣体，不过十七岁，却已经是神藏境的强者。
虽然比不上姜玉婵，但在年轻一代中，也是佼佼者。
不过辰南的目光只在她的身上停留了一息，便望向了第二道倩影。
“林轻眉！”
辰南眼睛微眯，没想到竟然会在这里遇见林轻眉。
他突然想起来，林轻眉和林梦瑶似乎是闺蜜。
甚至林轻眉与萧天麟，也是林梦瑶从中撮合的。
还真是冤家路窄啊！
“少主救我，他想杀我灭口！”
此时林天南见到林梦瑶的到来，顿时两眼放光，如见救星，迅速呼救。
虽然林梦瑶的实力比他低，但辰南只有一块圣主令，本身却只是轮海境罢了。
因此他相信，只要林梦瑶出手，辰南必败无疑，自己也能获救。
“辰南，你好大的胆子，竟然仗着圣主赐下的圣主令为非作歹，欺负我林家族老！”
“还不赶紧放人！”
林梦瑶见到林天南被镇压在地，顿时俏脸一变，怒视辰南，厉声呵斥。
“为非作歹？”
“你们让我身败名裂，然后被诸脉孤立，难道就不是为非作歹了吗？”
“既然你们想让我变成恶人，那我就作恶给你们看看！”
辰南咧嘴一笑，旋即毫不犹豫的一爪落下。
六道本源真气加持，再加上气血极境，这一爪足有二十万斤的恐怖力量。
别说是一颗血肉脑袋，便是一块灵金都能被轻松抓碎。
噗嗤！
林天南的脑袋如豆腐般被轻松抓碎，顿时红的白的流淌一地。
林天南的眼睛瞪大，满是惊恐与骇然，显然是死不瞑目！
他身为林家族老，更是归一境九重的强者，竟然以这种方式被杀，真是憋屈至极。
“辰南，你竟然敢杀我林家族老！”
林梦瑶怒目圆睁，满脸不敢置信的看着辰南。

read2(); Chen Nan looked up and saw two beautiful figures.
The leader is a woman in purple.
She has a beautiful and picturesque face, her skin is as crystal clear as snow, and she has a beauty mark between her eyebrows, which adds a touch of seductiveness to her.
She has a pair of narrow red phoenix eyes, a straight nose, but thin lips, giving people a mean feeling.
With just one glance, Chen Nan recognized the identity of the woman in purple.
Lin Mengyao, the young master of the Lin family, is also the seventh saint of Ziwei Holy Land.
She is pregnant with the phoenix bone holy body. She is only seventeen years old, but she is already a strong person in the Shenzang Realm.
Although not as good as Jiang Yuchan, she is still a leader among the younger generation.
However, Chen Nan's eyes only stayed on her body for a breath, and then looked at the second beautiful figure.
"Lin Qingmei!"
Chen Nan narrowed his eyes slightly, not expecting to meet Lin Qingmei here.
He suddenly remembered that Lin Qingmei and Lin Mengyao seemed to be best friends.
Even Lin Qingmei and Xiao Tianlin were brought together by Lin Mengyao.
It’s really a narrow road for enemies!
"Young Master, save me, he wants to kill me and silence me!"
At this time, Lin Tiannan saw Lin Mengyao's arrival, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he quickly called for help as if he saw a savior.
Although Lin Mengyao's strength is lower than him, Chen Nan only has a Holy Lord Token, but he is only in the Wheel and Sea realm.
Therefore, he believed that as long as Lin Mengyao took action, Chen Nan would be defeated and he would be saved.
"Chen Nan, you are so brave, you actually relied on the Holy Lord's order given by the Holy Lord to do evil and bully me, the elder of the Lin family!"
"Let him go quickly!"
When Lin Mengyao saw Lin Tiannan being suppressed to the ground, her pretty face suddenly changed, she glared at Chen Nan and scolded him sternly.
"Doing evil?"
"You ruined my reputation and then isolated me from all my connections. Isn't that just a crime?"
"Since you want me to become a bad person, then I will do evil for you to see!"
Chen Nan grinned and immediately lowered his claws without hesitation.
Blessed by the six original true qi, coupled with the extreme state of qi and blood, this claw has a terrifying power of two hundred thousand kilograms.
Not to mention a head of flesh and blood, even a piece of spiritual gold can be easily broken into pieces.
Poof!
Lin Tiannan's head was scratched to pieces as easily as tofu, and red and white blood immediately flowed all over the floor.
Lin Tiannan's eyes widened, full of fear and horror, and he obviously refused to rest in peace!
As an elder of the Lin family and a strong man at the ninth level of the Guiyi Realm, he was extremely aggrieved to be killed in this way.
"Chen Nan, how dare you kill me, the elder of the Lin family!"
Lin Mengyao's eyes widened angrily and she looked at Chen Nan in disbelief.
